design_status: prospective before any new covariance/normal derivative or tangent-step computation; saved residual/source inspection allowed
objective: Diagnose which local residual directions remain distinguishable after brightness, geometry and fixed-normal nuisance projection. No nonlinear inverse fit, rerender, re-preparation, optical calibration or automatic CAD adoption.
observation_contract: Reuse archived observed40train/16held positions/values and metadata exactly; geometry/levels fixed at each archivedbest. Each of5 pairedlanes has shared samples. No truth access in diagnostic/step selection; truth read only after predictions for descriptive evaluation. Directly check stored crop/selected values against pinned NPZ g in the archived local/global coordinate frames, without calling preparation.
sampling_limits: Heldoutvalues affected preprocessing/moments and are not independent prediction.
No IIDnoise, significance, confidence or physical-accuracy claim.
geometry_scaling: Multiply each geometric meanJac column by its archived observed-domain width; coordinates represent fractions of those domain widths.
brightness: Use columns1-P,P for levels strictly interior to [0,255] with64eps*255 activeguard. Fixed-bound columns excluded; retain activefaces. Rank/steps are conditional on this fixed active face, not the full feasible inward tangent cone.

covariance_chart.generated_arithmetic: Validate supplied Sigma0 strictly with no symmetry repair. For each GENERATED L exp(S)L.T only, record raw entries/asymmetry, require finite and asymmetry <=64eps*maxabs(raw) (zero scale handled explicitly), canonicalize .5*(raw+raw.T), record maximum entry change, then validate positive definiteness. Refuse any larger or nonfinite discrepancy.

finite_differences.status: unknown if either resolution or h/half-h stability fails

rank_policy.reference: Unprojected respective block spectral norm; never renormalize projectedroundoff. Retain singularspectra; covariancecutoff=max(64eps*maxdimension*unprojectednorm,4*FDdiscrepancynorm).
rank_policy.near_cutoff: Report CUTOFF-SENSITIVITY interval from2*cutoff andcutoff/2; this is not a rigorous true-rank/confidence interval. Rank0 means no directions resolved under this estimated guard, not proof of no physical information. Require stable full-column rank for an actual step; enforce residual-dimension ceiling.
rank_policy.forward_error_propagation: For each central FD column use (eta_plus+eta_minus)/(2*h) in level units, for both h and h/2; retain elementwise estimates. For G retain analytic per-row error estimates and multiply by |contrast| and each domain width. Include propagated uncertainty and h/half-h discrepancy in block and full-step cutoffs, not discrepancy alone. These are estimated numerical guards, not certified bounds.
rank_policy.comparison_cutoff: Within each nuisance-versus-augmented comparison use one reference cutoff derived from the UNPROJECTED concatenated blocks and their retained error estimates; report projected C spectrum against that same scale and residual-dimension ceiling.
rank_policy.error_combination: Conservatively ADD elementwise h/half-h discrepancies and propagated forward/analytic derivative-error arrays before a spectral or Frobenius norm; retain the separate arrays. No cancellation of estimated error terms.
rank_policy.projector_uncertainty: For nuisance T with FULL column rank and smin(T)>etaT (retained analytic/FD estimates plus SVD/projector arithmetic), use etaP=min(1,2*etaT/(smin(T)-etaT)); etaC=etaS+etaP*(||S||2+etaS), plus projection arithmetic. Cutoff for projectedS includes4etaC and the original unprojected comparison scale. If the full-rank/gap condition fails or etaP>=1, covariance uniqueness and step qualification are unknown/withheld. Empty exact nuisance span has etaP0; exactly known algebraic fixed-rank controls may use etaT0 without a full-column-rank assumption.
rank_policy.covariance_cutoff: max(64eps*maxdimension*UNPROJECTED concatenated spectral norm,4*etaC) with etaC defined from both FD scales/discrepancy, forward-error propagation, nuisance projector uncertainty and arithmetic. Full-step SVD uses its analogous concatenated estimated-error cutoff.

steps.fit_source: TRAINING ROWS ONLY SVD leastsquares of unprojected complete meanJac; joint LINEARIZED level/geometry/covariance(/normal) update. No nonlinear optimizer or exact box re-profiling of levels at the trial.
steps.damping: one common alpha=min(1, allcaps/allproposedcomponent sizes, .9 ofdistance to each geometric andlevel bound). No line search or repeatstep.
steps.qualification: Only local linearization behavior when finite/source/work/FD/rank/domainchecks pass; no fitting or scientific-target success is inferred.
steps.solve: Use the SAME stable retained SVD space/cutoff as reported for that complete training matrix; do not call default-lstsq with another tolerance. Withhold the actual step when full column rank or its rank interval is unresolved. No discarded direction is restored by the coefficient solver.
steps.covariance_norm_definition: Frobenius norm of sum(delta_q_i E_i), equal to Euclidean norm of delta_q. Actual update is Sigma=L exp(alpha*sum(delta_q_i E_i)) L.T.
steps.zero_policy: Skip zero-denominator cap terms. Exactly zero coefficient vector uses alpha1 and retains unchanged predictions as zero_step, not a recovered parameter. A required alpha0 is a withheld bound-limited step, not success.
steps.level_bounds: Apply the same common alpha to FREE level deltas and verify both actual trial levels remain in [0,255]. Fixed active levels stay fixed on their declared face.
steps.actual_vs_linear_metric: max over ALL56 queries of abs(actual_trial_mean - baseline_mean - alpha*J*delta) <= .001 + .05*max over ALL56 abs(alpha*J*delta). Evaluated AFTER training-only coefficients and alpha are fixed; neither heldout values nor this test can select/retune alpha or repeat a step.
